description: This file defines controller functions for task-related operations in a Node.js backend, including creating, listing, updating, deleting, and setting the status of tasks. It interacts with a TaskModel for database operations and handles HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new task, including optional template assignment, with request data processed from req.body and user info from req.user.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all tasks associated with the requesting user, considering user roles and parent-child relationships.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by taskId with provided fields, ensuring permissions are correct.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the task identified by taskId, restricted to parent users.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific task, with permissions depending on user role and assignment.

ctags.name: t
ctags.pattern: /^    const t = await TaskModel.updateTaskStatus(taskId, req.user.id, req.user.role, status);$/

ctags.name: tasks
ctags.pattern: /^  const tasks = await TaskModel.getTasksForUser(req.user.id, req.user.role, req.user.parentId);$/

ctags.name: updated
ctags.pattern: /^    const updated = await TaskModel.updateTask(taskId, req.user.id, updateFields);$/
